L3-0184.note: Comma-free single gloss; kept off 面积 L3 'area in size' and 规模 L4 'scale'.

L3-0191.note: 参观 L2 ships 'to visit' and 看望 L4 ships 'to pay a visit to'; 访问 is the formal or official visit, and the interview sense.

L3-0192.note: No CEDICT row and no official POS; transparent compound 放 + 到.

L3-0195.note: Led with 'expenses' so it does not sit on top of 成本 L5 'costs'.

L3-0196.note: POS V/Adv, verb first per the standard. 分开 L2 already ships 'to separate', so the verb gloss is the 'take leave of one another' sense.

L3-0197.note: V row. Dropped CEDICT's hard-drive "to partition" sense as off-level.

L3-0198.note: No official POS. Dropped CEDICT's networking 'packet' sense.

L3-0208.note: POS V/Adj; both senses are genuinely met at L3 (负责这个项目 / 他很负责).

L3-0212.note: 改善 L4 ships 'to make better', so 改进 takes the 'refine a method or product' framing.

meanings: to catch a bus or train

L3-0219.note: Dropped CEDICT's polite '(may I) venture', which is literary.

L3-0223.note: CEDICT row is only a variant pointer. Kept off 为什么 'why'.

meanings: at all in a negative sentence

L3-0244.note: N row. The CL: line is dictionary plumbing; 收入 L2 keeps "income".

L3-0256.note: Adj row. 古老 L5 ships 'ancient', so 古 leads with the time framing.

L3-0271.note: Adj row; distinct from 巨大 L4 'huge'.

L3-0279.note: This row is POS N, while 过去 at L2 is the verb 'to go over'. Cross-level pair had to be separated; the noun card takes the time sense.

L3-0280.note: POS Phonetic. Glossing it 'ha ha' is the word's own romanization, so the function is described instead.

L3-0282.note: 怕 L2 already ships 'to be afraid', so 害怕 leads with 'to be scared'.

L3-0284.note: Hard case: the standard lists Adj/Adv, but the overwhelming L3 use is adverbial (好好学习, 好好休息). Adjective sense kept second.

L3-0285.note: Adj row, so the noun clauses ('curiosity') do not lead.

meanings: to close a book or the eyes
L3-0286.note: 关 L1 ships "to shut", so 合 is pinned to the fold-together sense.

L3-0307.note: N row. Dropped CEDICT's adjective "ambient" and the CL: line.

L3-0313.note: Adj row. 主动 L3 ships 'spontaneous / active', so 积极 needed the enthusiasm framing.
